title: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Modeling: A Problem-Driven Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2604.14025v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reconstructing 3D representations from 2D inputs is a fundamental task in computer vision and graphics, serving as a cornerstone for understanding and interacting with the physical world. While traditional methods achieve high fidelity, they are limited by slow per-scene optimization or category-specific training, which hinders their practical deployment and scalability. Hence, generalizable feed-forward 3D reconstruction has witnessed rapid development in recent years. By learning a model that maps images directly to 3D representations in a single forward pass, these methods enable efficient reconstruction and robust cross-scene generalization. translated_title: 前馈式三维场景建模：一个问题驱动的视角
translated_abstract: 从二维输入中重建三维表示是计算机视觉与图形学中的一项基础任务，是理解和与物理世界交互的基石。虽然传统方法能够达到较高的保真度，但其受限于缓慢的逐场景优化或面向特定类别的训练，这阻碍了其实际部署与可扩展性。因此，可泛化的前馈式三维重建近年来得到了快速发展。通过学习一个能够在单次前向传播中将图像直接映射为三维表示的模型，这些方法实现了高效重建和强大的跨场景泛化能力。本综述源于一个关键观察：尽管几何输出表示多种多样——从隐式场到显式基元——现有的前馈方法都共享相似的高层架构模式，例如图像特征提取主干、多视图……
tldr: 本综述以问题驱动的视角系统梳理了前馈式三维场景建模领域，指出尽管几何输出表示各异（从隐式场到显式基元），现有方法仍共享相似的高层架构模式，从而实现单次前向传播即可完成高效且可跨场景泛化的三维重建。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a problem-driven perspective on feed-forward 3D scene modeling, showing that despite diverse output representations ranging from implicit fields to explicit primitives, existing approaches share similar high-level architectural patterns, enabling efficient and cross-scene-generalizable 3D reconstruction in a single forward pass.
